metric: CPU calculated from observed main-process and descendant CPU time. 100% equals one logical CPU fully occupied.
limitations: One completed shared-machine capture; not a query-latency or startup-speed benchmark.
Helpers outside the observed process trees, including macOS-managed WebKit helpers, are excluded. No extra helper PIDs were supplied.
External database servers and unrelated system services are excluded.
Results vary with workload, app version, hardware, power mode, and background activity.
